rows.title: 验证码错误
rows.expected: 提示验证码错误，不发放令牌
rows.actual: 验证码错误被拒：「验证码错误或已过期」，仍停留 http://localhost:5173/login
rows.evidence: [HTTP 400] POST /api/v1/auth/login ; [console.error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400 (Bad Request)

rows.title: 密码错误
rows.actual: 错误密码被拒：「账号或密码错误」
rows.evidence: [HTTP 401] POST /api/v1/auth/login ; [console.error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)

rows.title: 未审批账号登录（注册闭环）
steps: 用刚注册的 uistu162059 登录
rows.expected: 提示账号正在审批中，拒绝登录
rows.actual: 未审批账号被正确拦截：「账号正在审批中，请耐心等待管理员审核」
rows.evidence: [HTTP 401] POST /api/v1/auth/login ; [console.error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)
rows.shot: shots/003_未审批账号登录_注册闭环_.png

rows.title: 管理员正常登录
rows.expected: 登录成功并进入工作台
